title: Trydeas: Blue Skies Meals
description: Adds new Foods based on the dimensions of Blue Skies. A lot coming in updates!
body:
# <center>![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e092d73ecec01f8e51c5d6559b8d954d2d329019.png)


# <center> ABOUT: </center>
Add some food based in two of Blue Skies dimensions! Currently in progress, but a lot in coming!.

## Food List:
- Monitor Cut
- Cooked Monitor Cut
- Monitor Sandwich
- Horizonite Tunid Slice
- Cooked Horizonite Tunid Slice
- Grittle Flatfish Slice
- Cooked Grittle Flatfish Slice
- Municipal Monkfish Slice
- Cooked Municipal Monkfish Slice
- Charscale Moki Slice
- Cooked Charscale Moki Slice

## Knives List:
- Pyrope Knife
- Aquite Knife
- Diopside Knife
- Charoite Knife
- Horizonite Knife

## Important:
- The mod is in progress, i would add new food often if it's possible.
- I know that textures is not the best, but i would try to improves.
- Blocks and other type of foods and drinks is planned.
